blocks.text: This AnyMount ac support bracket ensures you can safely, securely, and efficiently install your window AC unit to enjoy cool, free-flowing air. This air conditioner window bracket is a medium and large universal fit, capable of supporting 12,000 BTU units up to 165 lbs. Installation is a breeze with our window air conditioner bracket (17.1" x 9.4" x 6.5") thanks to a built-in bubble level indicator for ease and precision. This window ac support bracket will mount on any surface up to 15.2" from the wall and has an adjustable arm height of 7.1" - 11.6". Stainless steel hardware is included, so you don't have to worry about a thing. Our bracket for ac window unit (2.9 lbs.) allows you a peace of mind when enjoying air conditioning in hotter months. Rest well at night with your AC on high knowing your unit is safely and securely installed outside your window. This window ac unit bracket is a must-have for any rooms without central AC. So what are you waiting for? Welcome summertime with this AnyMount window air conditioner support bracket.

items.label: AC Support
items.value: Stay cool in summer months with our ANYMOUNT mounting bracket (17.1" x 9.4" x 6.5") for AC units. Enjoy reliable indoor ac unit support up to 12,000 BTUs or 165 lbs.

items.label: Universal
items.value: Our heavy duty shelf brackets are a medium and large universal window AC unit fit, mounting easily and conveniently on any surface up to 15.2" from wall.

items.label: Easy Installation
items.value: Install your window ac bracket (2.9 lbs.) easily from the comfort of your own home. Our air conditioner bracket comes with a built-in bubble level indicator for precision.

items.label: Adjustable Height
items.value: Enjoy an adjustable arm height (7.1" - 11.6") when installing your air conditioner window unit with our ac mounting bracket. No hassle, and accommodating of your installation needs!

items.label: Everything Included
items.value: All necessary hardware is included in this ANYMOUNT portable air conditioner window kit. Enjoy cool air all summer long with this heavy duty window air conditioner support.
